Package com.example.lotterize

Class NotificationSender

java.lang.Object
com.example.lotterize.NotificationSender
public class NotificationSender extends Object
This is a helper class responsible for sending Notification objects to Firestore.

It supports:

  • Sending notifications from primitive fields (sender id, message, list of candidate receiver ids),
  • Filtering candidate receivers based on each user's wantNotification flag in the users collection,
  • Writing a new document into the notifications collection,
  • Optionally reporting the number of recipients via a callback.

  • Method Details

    • sendNotification

      public void sendNotification(String senderId, String message, ArrayList<String> receiversIds, NotificationSender.NotificationCallback callback)
      This sends a notification to the given list of candidate receivers, with an optional callback to report the result.

      This method:

      1. Chunks receiversIds into groups of at most 10 ids (due to Firestore whereIn limits),
      2. Queries the users collection for each chunk to check the wantNotification flag,
      3. Builds a final list of recipients that have not opted out,
      4. If at least one recipient remains, writes a new document into the notifications collection,
      5. Invokes NotificationSender.NotificationCallback.onComplete(int) with the number of recipients, or NotificationSender.NotificationCallback.onError(Exception) on failure.
      Parameters:
      senderId - user id of the sender
      message - body or content of the notification
      receiversIds - list of candidate user ids who should receive the notification
      callback - optional callback invoked when the operation completes or fails; may be null if the caller does not care about the result

    • sendNotification

      public void sendNotification(String senderId, String message, ArrayList<String> receiversIds)
      This method is an overload of sendNotification(String, String, ArrayList, NotificationCallback) that ignores the result and does not use a callback.

      This is useful for callers that only care about triggering the send and do not need to know how many recipients actually received the notification or whether it failed.

      Parameters:
      senderId - user id of the sender
      message - body or content of the notification
      receiversIds - list of candidate user ids who should receive the notification

    • sendNotification

      public void sendNotification(Notification notification)
      Sends a pre-built Notification. Missing fields are filled in as follows: - senderId is set from CurrentUser if it is null or empty. - senderName is set from the current user's name or username if it is null or empty. - time is set to the current timestamp if it is null. Candidate receiver IDs are filtered using the wantNotification flag in the "users" collection. If notificationId is null or empty, a new document is created in the "notifications" collection and its ID is stored in the notification. If no recipients remain after filtering, nothing is written.
      Parameters:
      notification - notification object to send.
